verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law service with a secure client portal. An official MCP server for case or portal access is a conceivable capability for such a service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or any agent-facing API: the llms.txt probe only shows a descriptive text file, and every OpenAPI probe path returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
